title: ReaderDock picks white-on-accent in Paper dark mode, where accent is light
acceptance: The dock's active toggle capsule has adequate contrast in all four appearances: Paper light, Paper dark, Sepia, Night
onAccentInk is chosen from the resolved accent luminance rather than from the theme case
The measured ratios are added to ReaderContrastAudit so this cannot regress
notes: Found by the T-0014 agent while auditing contrast. ReaderDock.onAccentInk selects white-on-accent for every theme except .night, but Paper in DARK appearance also resolves accent to the light peachy value — so the active toggle likely renders white text on a light fill. The bug is that the choice keys off the theme case rather than the resolved colour's luminance. Outside T-0014's touches (Stacks/Design/** only), so correctly left alone.
